Title: Azure Machine Learning updates December 2020 in public preview

Body.Content:
Azure Machine Learning has the following updates -

  • Custom Views (public preview) : The Azure Machine Learning Experimentation UI now allows data scientists to explicitly save to the cloud the edits to their Experiment view. Users can now organize and keep track of their runs and run comparisons by using ‘Custom Views’.
  • Cross-Experiment Run Comparison (public preview): The feature would enable users to view, filter, graphically compare, and visualize runs on the charts across experiments in a Workspace. It will also allow them to monitor their status, run progress and compare run performance. The users will be able to customize their Custom views, save, and share with colleagues for feedback/collaboration.

Learn more.

Try for free.
